entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4655144838329879168 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/hv-878/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 878: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 49845.2 +/- 1707.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 49845.2 +/- 1707.2 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax -0.0127 +/- 0.0197 mas (same row, RUWE 2.09), -0.6 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 2.002, -0.093 mas/yr. Radial velocity: Gaia DR3 (same row): 262.59 +/- 2.12 km/s.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 111.2 +/- 3.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 878: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 111.2 +/- 3.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 77,361,840 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0501, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5500 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4655144838329879168: 5 G-band harmonics of a 23.325349889696646 d period, peak-to-peak 1.247 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.06 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,500 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.058 +/- 0.005 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffede1. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,500 K and log g 0.3 (u1 0.548, u2 0.159): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 0.3 from 2022A&A...658A..29R; the 4 published values span log g 0.3 to 1.23, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.1% of the centre brightness.
